نضم (form I)
# نَضُمُّ (naḍummu) /na.dˤum.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of ضَمَّ (ḍamma)
# نُضَمُّ (nuḍammu) /nu.dˤam.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of ضَمَّ (ḍamma)
# نَضُمَّ (naḍumma) /na.dˤum.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of ضَمَّ (ḍamma)
# نُضَمَّ (nuḍamma) /nu.dˤam.ma/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/
